title: panel triad leg — three lenses, one union of findings
description: Output contract of one triad panel leg. The leg applies all three triad lenses (references/triad/prompts/architecture.md, correctness.md, cold-read.md) and returns every finding in one items array, each tagged with the lens that produced it. The finding fields are the union of architecture.schema.json and correctness.schema.json plus cold-read.md's markdown fields; a field a lens does not use is the empty string. The classifier assigns item ids <lab>-<n> by position.

status.description: One status per lens, as each base prompt defines it.

items.description: Every finding of every lens. Empty when all three lenses found nothing. Ordered by severity within each lens.

lens.description: The lens whose prompt this finding answers.

what.description: The defect (architecture: and the path traced to find it; cold-read: what's unclear, assumed, or misleading).

evidence.description: architecture: the named consumer, decision-log entry, or arch doc checked. Empty string for the other lenses.

trigger.description: correctness: the concrete input or sequence that causes it, and the wrong outcome. Empty string for the other lenses.

spec.description: correctness: the ticket line it violates, or "edge case — not in ticket". Empty string for the other lenses.

first_read.description: cold-read: what you initially thought, if it differed from what you concluded. Empty string for the other lenses or when it did not differ.
